candidates.description:
Apple was rescued by Kimberly, founder of an animal shelter, because Apple has hydrocephalus.

Most baby foxes with this condition are usually euthanized when they arrive, because there has been almost no hope for treatment.

But Kimberly never felt right about giving up on them, so she started trying to give these babies a real chance at life.

Now Apple may need an expensive surgery to help save her life.

That’s why all fees are being donated to her animal shelter, Arctic Fox Daily Rescue, and the donations have already reached over $30,000.

Apple is not just a cute fox going viral. Her story is much bigger. She has a rare and serious medical condition, and she could help create a new chance for baby foxes with hydrocephalus instead of giving up on them.

That’s why the PumpFun charity feature was launched.

This is the kind of charity coin that actually makes sense and truly deserves support.
